title: Build CivicGuard AI - Full-Stack Civic Tech Reporting Platform

requirements.text: Implement user authentication system with role-based access control supporting three roles: Citizen, Authority, and Admin
acceptanceCriteria: Users can register and login with role assignment
Citizen role has access to reporting and tracking features
Authority role can review and update complaint status
Admin role has full system access including user management
Role-based UI components render based on authenticated user role

requirements.text: Create image upload functionality with automatic location and timestamp tagging for civic issue reporting (tobacco spit, garbage, traffic violations, public nuisance)

quotes: AI image & 30–90 sec video reporting (tobacco spit ,garbage, traffic violations, public nuisance)

acceptanceCriteria: Users can upload images when creating a report
Location coordinates are automatically captured and attached to the report
Timestamp is automatically recorded when image is captured
Support for multiple issue categories: tobacco spit, garbage, traffic violations, public nuisance
Images are stored securely in the backend

requirements.text: Implement video upload functionality supporting 30-90 second videos for civic issue reporting with automatic location and timestamp tagging
acceptanceCriteria: Users can upload videos between 30-90 seconds in length
Video upload validates duration constraints
Location and timestamp are automatically tagged to video reports
Videos are stored securely in the backend
Video file size is managed appropriately for web delivery

requirements.text: Build complaint generation system that creates structured complaint documents from user reports including issue type, location, timestamp, media evidence, and description
acceptanceCriteria: System automatically generates structured complaint document from report data
Complaint includes issue category, location details, timestamp, media references, and user description
Structured format is consistent across all complaint types
Generated complaint is stored and retrievable
Complaint document can be viewed and downloaded by the reporter

requirements.text: Implement one-tap helpline integration supporting 112 (emergency), 1969 (traffic police), and 103 (ambulance) with automatic city municipal contact detection based on user location

quotes: One-tap helpline integration (112, 1969, 103 + auto city municipal detection)

acceptanceCriteria: Users can access quick dial buttons for 112, 1969, and 103
System detects user's city based on location
Municipal helpline contact is automatically displayed for detected city
Helpline buttons are prominently displayed and easily accessible
UI clearly labels each helpline with its purpose

requirements.text: Create complaint status tracking system with four states: Received, Under Review, Action Taken, and Escalated, allowing users to view current status and status history of their reports

quotes: Complaint status tracking (Received, Under Review, Action Taken, Escalated)

acceptanceCriteria: Each complaint has a status field that can be one of: Received, Under Review, Action Taken, Escalated
Citizens can view the current status of their submitted complaints
Authority users can update complaint status
Status change history is tracked with timestamps
Users receive visual indication of status changes

requirements.text: Implement anonymous reporting option that allows users to submit complaints without revealing their identity while maintaining report functionality
acceptanceCriteria: Users can toggle anonymous mode when creating a report
Anonymous reports do not display reporter identity to authorities
Anonymous reporters receive a unique tracking ID to check report status
System maintains report integrity without storing personal identifiers for anonymous reports
Anonymous option is clearly presented in the reporting UI

requirements.text: Build real-time civic heatmap dashboard displaying geographic distribution of reported civic issues with color-coded intensity based on report frequency
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard displays a map view of the city with heatmap overlay
Heatmap color intensity reflects the density of civic issues in each area
Map updates in real-time or near real-time as new reports are submitted
Users can filter heatmap by issue type
Heatmap is visually clear and accessible on mobile devices

requirements.text: Implement area-wise civic score calculation system that generates cleanliness and discipline index scores for different geographic areas based on report frequency and resolution rates
acceptanceCriteria: System calculates civic scores for geographic areas (neighborhoods, districts)
Score calculation incorporates cleanliness metrics based on garbage and tobacco spit reports
Score calculation incorporates discipline metrics based on traffic violations and public nuisance reports
Scores are normalized and displayed as easy-to-understand ratings
Area scores are updated periodically as new reports are processed

requirements.text: Create gamified civic score system with user badges and city-level and school-level leaderboards to encourage civic participation

quotes: Gamified Civic Score, badges & leaderboard (city + school level)

acceptanceCriteria: Users earn civic score points for submitting valid reports
System awards badges for milestones (first report, 10 reports, 50 reports, etc.)
City-level leaderboard displays top contributors with their scores
School-level leaderboard is available for student users
Leaderboards and badges are displayed in user profiles
Gamification elements use simple, encouraging language

requirements.text: Build volunteer and NGO task marketplace where organizations can post civic improvement tasks and volunteers can browse and accept assignments
acceptanceCriteria: NGO and organization accounts can create and post civic tasks
Tasks include description, location, required volunteers, and time commitment
Volunteers can browse available tasks and express interest or commit
Task status tracking shows open, in-progress, and completed tasks
Volunteers receive recognition in their profiles for completed tasks

requirements.text: Implement automatic escalation system that sends 72-hour reminder notifications to authorities for pending complaints and escalates unresolved issues to higher authorities

quotes: Auto-escalation system (72hr reminder + higher authority escalation)

acceptanceCriteria: System tracks time elapsed since complaint was submitted or last updated
Automatic reminder is sent to assigned authority at 72 hours if status remains 'Received' or 'Under Review'
If no action is taken after reminder, complaint status changes to 'Escalated'
Escalated complaints are reassigned to higher authority level
Escalation history is recorded in complaint timeline

requirements.text: Create RTI (Right to Information) draft auto-generator that helps users create properly formatted RTI requests based on their civic complaints
acceptanceCriteria: Users can select a complaint to generate an RTI draft
System generates RTI document with proper legal format and language
RTI draft includes complaint details, questions for authorities, and user information
Generated RTI is available in both Hindi and English
Users can download or copy the RTI draft for submission

requirements.text: Build before/after impact proof generator that allows users to submit follow-up images showing issue resolution and creates visual comparison documentation
acceptanceCriteria: Users can upload 'after' images for resolved complaints
System displays side-by-side comparison of before and after images
Impact proof includes timestamps for both images
Generated proof can be shared or downloaded
Visual comparison clearly demonstrates the improvement

requirements.text: Implement multi-language support for Hindi and English throughout the entire application including UI text, notifications, and generated documents
acceptanceCriteria: Users can switch between Hindi and English in app settings
All UI labels, buttons, and messages display in selected language
Complaint documents and RTI drafts are generated in selected language
Language preference persists across sessions
Text uses simple, easy-to-understand vocabulary in both languages

requirements.text: Create daily 5-question civic quiz feature with simple multiple-choice questions about civic responsibility, scoring system, and result display

quotes: Daily 5-question civic quiz (with simple answers and score)

acceptanceCriteria: New quiz with 5 questions is available each day
Questions cover topics like cleanliness, traffic rules, public behavior, environmental responsibility
Questions use simple language appropriate for all education levels
Users receive immediate feedback on their answers
Quiz score out of 5 is displayed after completion
Quiz history and scores are tracked in user profile

requirements.text: Implement daily civic fact feature that displays one educational fact each day in simple language about civic responsibility, cleanliness, or good citizenship

quotes: One daily civic fact in simple language

acceptanceCriteria: A new civic fact is displayed each day on the home screen or dedicated section
Facts are written in simple, accessible language
Facts cover topics like waste management, traffic safety, public health, environmental care
Facts are available in both Hindi and English
Users can view previous days' facts in a history section

requirements.text: Create daily moral story feature that presents one short story each day with positive messages about responsibility, cleanliness, and good citizenship in simple language

quotes: One short moral story every day

acceptanceCriteria: A new short moral story is available each day
Stories are 200-400 words in length with clear moral lessons
Stories emphasize civic values, community responsibility, and positive behavior
Stories use simple, engaging language suitable for all ages
Stories are available in both Hindi and English
Story archive allows users to read previous stories

requirements.text: Implement motivational video section featuring age-appropriate motivational content for mature audiences in user's selected language (Hindi or English)

quotes: Motivational videos for mature people in the selected language

acceptanceCriteria: Video section is accessible from main navigation
Videos feature motivational content about civic responsibility and community improvement
Video titles and descriptions display in user's selected language
Content is appropriate for adult audiences
Videos are organized by category or theme
Video player works smoothly on mobile devices

requirements.text: Create tobacco spit-free public report section with dedicated reporting interface and awareness messaging about health and cleanliness impacts of tobacco spitting

quotes: Tobacco spit-free public report section with awareness message

acceptanceCriteria: Dedicated section for reporting tobacco spit violations with simplified interface
Section displays educational awareness message about health risks and public cleanliness
Awareness content uses simple, impactful language
Report submission follows same process as other civic issues
Statistics on tobacco spit reports are displayed to show community impact
Content is available in both Hindi and English

requirements.text: Design and implement mobile-first dark modern UI with clean layout, easy navigation, and consistent dark theme throughout the application that emphasizes cleanliness, responsibility, and good citizenship

quotes: Keep the design clean and easy to use
Focus on cleanliness, responsibility, and good citizenship

acceptanceCriteria: UI is optimized for mobile screen sizes first, then scales to desktop
Dark theme is applied consistently across all pages and components
Color scheme uses modern, professional dark colors with appropriate contrast
Navigation is intuitive and requires minimal clicks to reach key features
Typography is clear and readable on dark background
Visual design emphasizes civic themes through iconography and imagery
UI responds smoothly to touch interactions on mobile devices
Design follows accessibility best practices for dark mode

requirements.text: Implement REST API architecture with structured endpoints for authentication, complaint management, user profiles, gamification features, educational content, and administrative functions
acceptanceCriteria: API endpoints follow RESTful conventions
Endpoints are organized by resource type (users, complaints, tasks, content)
All endpoints return consistent JSON response format
API includes proper error handling with meaningful error messages
Endpoints require appropriate authentication and authorization
API documentation is available for integration purposes

constraints: Do not implement real-time WebSocket features for instant updates
Do not integrate third-party AI services like OpenAI or Anthropic for image analysis
Do not implement actual SMS or push notification services
Do not integrate external mapping services or GPS APIs beyond basic location capture
Do not implement actual phone calling functionality - helpline integration should display contact information only
Do not implement facial recognition or license plate detection algorithms
All backend logic must reside in a single Motoko actor
Frontend must use React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and React Query only
Do not edit immutable frontend paths: useInternetIdentity.ts, useInternetIdentity.tsx, useActor.ts, main.tsx, components/ui
Authentication must use Internet Identity, not third-party services
Do not implement external database systems - use Motoko stable storage
nonGoals: Actual AI-powered image/video analysis or content validation
Real face blurring or number plate detection algorithms
Predictive AI for problem hotspot forecasting
Live video streaming or real-time video processing
Integration with actual government or municipal databases
Actual cloud storage services (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure)
Real SMS notifications or email services
Live phone calling through the app
Integration with real mapping or GPS services
Actual payment processing for donations or fees
Browser geolocation beyond basic coordinate capture
Real-time chat or messaging between users and authorities
Automated social media sharing or integration

Badge illustration for community leader achievement with crown design (badge-leader.dim_200x200.png)
Illustration for empty state when no reports exist showing clean neighborhood (empty-state-reports.dim_400x300.png)
Background pattern for dashboard sections with subtle civic-themed geometric design (bg-pattern-civic.dim_800x600.png)
